# DirectCare AI

> DirectCare AI is an AI-powered direct-to-patient telehealth platform delivering personalized, clinician-prescribed protocols across weight loss, hormones, sexual health, hair regrowth, supplements, blood labs, and chronic condition care. All treatments are reviewed by US-licensed clinicians and dosed against the patient's actual bloodwork.

DirectCare AI partners with US-licensed compounding pharmacies and clinical labs to deliver compounded medications (semaglutide, tirzepatide, testosterone, estradiol, progesterone, finasteride, minoxidil, tadalafil, sildenafil) and an 80+ biomarker hormone & longevity panel. Compounded medications are not FDA-approved as finished products; their active ingredients are individually FDA-approved.

## Products

- [Testosterone Replacement Therapy (TRT)](https://www.directcare.ai/testosterone-replacement-therapy): Injectable testosterone cypionate, oral testosterone undecanoate, and natural-pathway enclomiphene protocols, dose-titrated to bloodwork.
- [Hormone Replacement Therapy (HRT)](https://www.directcare.ai/hormone-replacement-therapy): Bioidentical estradiol, progesterone, and (where indicated) low-dose testosterone for women in their 40s and beyond.
- [Weight Loss (GLP-1)](https://www.directcare.ai/weight-loss/): Compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide for sustainable weight loss with clinician oversight.
- [Sexual Health (Surge Max)](https://www.directcare.ai/surge-max/): Compounded sildenafil, tadalafil, and combination protocols.
- [Hair Regrowth — Men](https://www.directcare.ai/mens-hair-loss/): Topical and oral finasteride/dutasteride and minoxidil protocols.
- [Hair Regrowth — Women](https://www.directcare.ai/womans-hair-loss/): Hormonal-panel-driven hair-loss protocols for women.
- [Blood Labs](https://www.directcare.ai/blood-test/): Clinician-ordered 80+ biomarker panel with a plain-English roadmap, $196.
- [Supplements](https://www.directcare.ai/supplements/): Physician-formulated supplement protocols matched to bloodwork.
- [Peptides](https://www.directcare.ai/peptides): Clinician-prescribed peptide protocols (BPC-157, ipamorelin, sermorelin, GHK-Cu, PT-141) for recovery, sleep, and metabolic health, where clinically appropriate.
- [Chronic Condition Care](https://www.directcare.ai/chronic-care): Remote patient monitoring and chronic care management with ongoing clinician oversight.

## The Blog (editorial)

- [The DirectCare AI Blog](https://www.directcare.ai/blog/): Plain-English breakdowns of the science behind hormone therapy, weight loss, sexual health, hair regrowth, blood labs, and supplements. Updated daily with clinician-written posts.
- [Posts manifest (JSON)](https://www.directcare.ai/blog/posts.json): Machine-readable list of all blog posts with slug, title, excerpt, category, date, image, and keywords.
- [RSS feed](https://www.directcare.ai/blog/rss.xml): Full-post RSS feed, updated daily.

## Compliance & trust

- US-licensed clinicians review every protocol.
- HIPAA-compliant infrastructure.
- LegitScript-approved.
- All compounded medications prepared at US-licensed compounding pharmacies.
- This site is for informational purposes and does not constitute medical advice.
